item.title: Article: Post-Quantum Cryptography in Spring Boot: Four Patterns You Can Ship This Sprint
item.description: There are four patterns that bring PQC into a Spring Boot fleet: encrypting payloads between services, locking down database fields, signing documents that need to hold up for decades, and moving service tokens off RS256. (1 source: infoq)
